query: WITH RECURSIVE subtree AS (SELECT id FROM central.workflow_nodes WHERE id = $1::uuid UNION ALL SELECT n.id FROM central.workflow_nodes n JOIN subtree s ON n.parent_node_id = s.id ) SELECT ref FROM (SELECT e.artifact_id AS ref FROM central.workflow_edges e JOIN central.workflow_nodes d ON d.id = e.dependent_node_id WHERE e.kind = 'artifact' AND d.id IN (SELECT id FROM subtree) AND d.state NOT IN ('succeeded', 'cancelled')UNION SELECT (r->>'artifact_id')::uuid FROM central.workflow_nodes n CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(n.input_artifact_refs) r WHERE n.id IN (SELECT id FROM subtree) AND n.state NOT IN ('succeeded', 'cancelled')) refs WHERE ref IN (SELECT id FROM central.artifacts WHERE state = 'ready') ORDER BY 1
